meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of splatter.
meaning.vi: Thì quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ của splatter.

sentences.vi: Những hạt mưa rơi tí tách vào đầu cô.

sentences.en: A lot of blood gets splattered around without anyone getting too badly hurt or taking too much offense.

sentences.en: Taran stood over Memon's body, his gaze taking in the blood splattered in both cells.

sentences.en: One night we left droppings splattered around in my grandmother's penthouse while elephants scratched mom 's favorite pink Cadillac.

sentences.en: You'll be having your favorite beach babes, football teams or films splattered across your pocket PC in no time.

sentences.en: Techies are also to blame with CVs being liberally splattered with teh agile word without any actual experience.

sentences.en: The court heard how he had left blood splattered on the kitchen walls, floor and utensils.

sentences.en: Trouble is, with October away an ' the last leaves splattered on the ground, the warm weather tends to vanish.

sentences.en: Better to use a low output Tesla coil, which generates high voltage splattered all over the RF spectrum.
